name: commit-defender
description: AI-powered pre-commit code review with priority-graded findings inline in VS Code. Ships its own self-contained git pre-commit hook.

commands.title: Commit Defender: Sign in with Codex
Commit Defender: Sign in with Claude Code
Commit Defender: Sign in with Antigravity
Commit Defender: Select Account Provider and Model
Commit Defender: Local Memory and Skills
Commit Defender: Manage Model API Credential

enumDescriptions: aoai (Azure OpenAI): Azure-hosted OpenAI models. Requires endpoint, api-version, and a deployment name as the model.
anthropic: Anthropic Claude models (claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6, etc.).
openai: OpenAI API. Select a model available to your account and compatible with the configured API adapter.
gemini: Google Gemini models (gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, etc.).
codex: Use the locally installed Codex CLI and its saved ChatGPT/Codex login. No API key required.
claudecode: Use the locally installed Claude Code CLI and its saved subscription login. No API key required.
antigravity: Use the locally installed Antigravity agy CLI and its saved account login. No API key required.
commitDefender.aiProvider.description: User-selected model provider, independent of central knowledge. Fixed-source reviews support Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity accounts and Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini APIs. Account CLIs must be installed and signed in locally. Reviews are advisory.

commitDefender.model.description: User-selected model or Azure deployment name. Codex verifies the selected model and reasoning against its bundled catalog. No automatic provider or model fallback.

commitDefender.endpoint.markdownDescription:
API endpoint URL. Required for `aoai`. For `openai`, `anthropic`, and `gemini`, leave empty to use the default public endpoint shown below.

**Per-provider endpoints:**

| Provider | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `aoai` | `https://YOUR_RESOURCE.openai.azure.com` |
| `anthropic` | `https://api.anthropic.com/v1` |
| `openai` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` |
| `gemini` | `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta` |

commitDefender.apiVersion.description: API version string. Used by aoai only (e.g. 2024-08-01-preview). Ignored for anthropic, openai, and gemini.

commitDefender.apiKey.description: Legacy plaintext API key. Preserved until you explicitly migrate it with Manage Model API Credential. Runtime API requests use a verified OS-backed credential reference.
commitDefender.apiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Run **Commit Defender: Manage Model API Credential** to move this value to encrypted OS-backed storage after verification.

commitDefender.codexPath.description: User-selected Codex executable. Review verifies CLI 0.153.4 or 0.154.0 and its capabilities before execution. Linux requires a private file-backed existing account; see platform coverage. Default discovery preserves your saved login.

commitDefender.claudeCodePath.description: Claude Code CLI executable name or absolute path. Used only by the claudecode account provider. Set an absolute path when git hooks or GUI git clients have a different PATH.

commitDefender.geminiCliPath.description: Gemini CLI executable name or absolute path. Used only by the geminicli account provider. Set an absolute path when git hooks or GUI git clients have a different PATH.
commitDefender.geminiCliPath.deprecationMessage: Legacy Gemini CLI integration. Select Antigravity in the account provider picker for fixed-source reviews. Existing settings are preserved.

commitDefender.antigravityPath.description: Antigravity agent CLI (agy) executable name or absolute path. The Antigravity IDE launcher cannot run reviews. Requires headless structured output and no-tools agents.

commitDefender.maxTokens.description: API provider output-token limit. The Codex executor does not apply a hard output-token limit.

enumDescriptions: severe: Zero tolerance — nearly all findings become P2 (Warning) or P3 (Critical).
rigorous: Strict — style issues escalate to P2 (Warning), most things flagged.
moderate: Balanced — P1/P2/P3 assigned by genuine impact. (default)
generous: Lenient — minor things become P1 (Info); only real risks reach P2/P3.
lean: Minimal — only P3 Critical (security, syntax errors, data-loss) issues flagged.
commitDefender.severityLevel.description: Controls how strictly the AI assigns priority levels. P1=Info, P2=Warning, P3=Critical. Manual and background shared-core reviews are advisory; commit blocking belongs to the separately enabled legacy hook.

enumDescriptions: colorful: Elaborate feedback with examples, alternatives, and detailed explanations.
chatty: Detailed feedback with helpful context for each finding.
moderate: Standard amount of detail — clear but concise. (default)
simple: Brief, to-the-point findings with minimal explanation.
silent: One-line summaries only — no elaboration.
commitDefender.richnessLevel.description: Controls the verbosity and detail level of each priority comment's explanation.

enumDescriptions: en: English
ko: 한국어

commitDefender.excludePatterns.description: Additional gitignore-style patterns to exclude from analysis (e.g. 'tests/**', '*.generated.ts'). Applied on top of the repo's .gitignore.

enumDescriptions: Theme Adaptive — inherits priority colors from your active VS Code theme via CSS variables. Recommended default.
Cobalt9 — electric navy-friendly accents tuned for Cobalt2/Cobalt9 themes.
Tailwind — modern web palette, high saturation, familiar.
Pastel Soft — low saturation, gentle on the eyes. Best on light themes.
Material — Google Material A-tones, punchy.
Solarized — muted terminal-familiar tones, lower contrast.
Muted Modern — Tailwind × Solarized blend; works on both light and dark themes.
Nord — arctic, cool, low visual noise.
Dracula — classic purple/pink/cyan dark-theme accents.
Gruvbox — 70s retro, earthy warm tones.
CVD Consensus (colorblind-safe) — balanced across light and dark themes.
CVD Deep (colorblind-safe) — darker tones tuned for light themes.
CVD Vivid (colorblind-safe) — electric tones tuned for dark themes.
Okabe-Ito (colorblind-safe) — canonical palette from Nature methodology papers.
commitDefender.colorPalette.markdownDescription:
Color palette for priority badges and category chips in the Commit Defender summary panel.

- **Default**: `theme-adaptive` inherits from your active VS Code theme.
- **Normal-vision**: `cobalt9`, `tailwind`, `pastel-soft`, `material`, `solarized`, `muted-modern`, `nord`, `dracula`, `gruvbox`.
- **Colorblind-safe**: `cvd-consensus`, `cvd-deep`, `cvd-vivid`, `okabe-ito`.

Changes re-render the open summary panel automatically. Extension-only — no env var.

commitDefender.runOnStage.description: Review actual staged changes after a 3 second debounce. User Settings only; new installs default off.

enumDescriptions: enable: Install the git pre-commit hook in the workspace repository on activation. The hook runs an AI review on every git commit, even outside VS Code.
disable: Do not install or manage the git pre-commit hook. Analysis is still available manually and on git stage.
commitDefender.preCommitHook.description: Controls the separate legacy pre-commit hook, which can block Git on P3. Not required for manual review, GCR history pulling or the advisory Automatic Reviews service.

commitDefender.fileTimeoutSeconds.description: Standalone model-run time limit in seconds (maximum 600). Preparation has a separate limit of the same duration. Zero uses the default 120 seconds. Legacy commit-message behavior is unchanged.

commitDefender.directoryTimeoutSeconds.description: Standalone model-run time limit in seconds (maximum 600). Preparation has a separate limit of the same duration. Zero uses the default 360 seconds. Legacy commit-message behavior is unchanged.

commitDefender.stagedFilesWarnThreshold.description: Show a warning prompt when the number of staged files exceeds this threshold before running analysis. Set to 0 to disable the prompt.

commitDefender.repoAnalysisWarnThreshold.description: Show a confirmation prompt when analyzing the full repository and the file count exceeds this threshold. Set to 0 to disable the prompt.

commitDefender.reviewMode.description: Default review mode from User Settings. Central review requires an explicit connection for the current profile and worktree. Use Central Review Connection to select a worktree override.

commitDefender.localProfile.description: Local profile shared with the GCR CLI. Repository knowledge and history are further separated by repository and worktree.

commitDefender.reviewReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning for review requests. Codex verifies model support. OpenAI and Azure receive reasoning_effort when nonempty. Leave empty for providers without a reasoning parameter. Existing saved choices are preserved.

commitDefender.modelCredentialRef.description: Reference created by Manage Model API Credential. Contains no secret. Bound to the local profile, provider, endpoint and model.

commitDefender.runOnSave.description: Review saved changes after a 3 second debounce. User Settings only; new installs default off.

commitDefender.reviewAutoSaves.description: Include VS Code Auto Save when saved-change review is enabled. User Settings only.

commitDefender.reviewExternalChanges.description: Include external file changes when saved-change review is enabled. User Settings only.

commitDefender.automaticReviewsPaused.description: Pause automatic reviews in all repositories. Manual review remains available. User Settings only.

commitDefender.automaticSaveIntervalSeco.description: Minimum interval between automatic Save review starts in this local profile/worktree. User Settings only.

commitDefender.automaticReviewsPerHour.description: Maximum automatic review starts per hour in this profile/worktree. Prior manual review starts also count toward this limit. This measures review invocations, not provider API requests or tokens.

commitDefender.runOnCommit.description: Review the exact commit index in the background after existing hooks succeed. User Settings only; new installs default off.

commitDefender.runOnPush.description: Review outgoing commit ranges in the background after the existing pre-push hook succeeds. User Settings only; new installs default off.

commitDefender.serviceNodePath.description: Node.js 22+ executable for the independent review service. User Settings only.

commitDefender.hookReviewWaitSeconds.description: Optionally wait for queued Commit/Push reviews. Zero returns after enqueue. Findings or review timeout do not change the existing Git hook exit policy.

walkthroughs.title: Commit Defender: GCR Connection Guide
walkthroughs.description: Read the guide, then open account, connection and Settings controls.

steps.title: How GCR and CD work together
steps.description:
GCR supplies review history, Skills, prompts, and published guidance. CD runs reviews with the account, provider, model, and reasoning you select. Connecting to GCR preserves those choices.
Local code and review results are not uploaded to GCR. Review source and context go to your selected model provider; account providers can use cloud inference.
This guide works offline. Step checks track pages read, not connection or review success.
[한국어](command:commitDefender.openConnectionGuide?%5B%22ko%22%5D)

steps.title: Prepare a GCR API key
steps.description:
On your GCR website, open Profile → Clients. Choose Commit Defender and one or more repositories, or all repositories currently accessible in the selected tenant. Issue a knowledge:read API key with a suitable expiry. New repositories need a new key.
Copy the HTTPS server URL shown on that page. No connection JSON is required. For a private CA, download the public CA certificate. The API key is separate from your GCR password, GitHub token, or model API key.

steps.title: Open the matching Git repository
steps.description:
Open the local Git repository or worktree in VS Code and trust the workspace. The Git remote is used locally to recognize this repository. It does not limit access to other authorized reference sources.
The connection belongs to the current local profile and worktree. Repository policy is automatically matched; other sources remain optional reference material.

steps.title: Choose your account and model
steps.description:
For account-based reviews, select Codex and your model in the account picker. CD uses your existing CLI login; choose Enter a model ID… if needed. A model account registered in GCR does not configure CD.
Open Settings for provider, model, endpoint, and review reasoning. For API providers, store secrets with Manage Model API Credential. Keep account and model choices in User Settings.
[Select account and model](command:commitDefender.selectAccountProviderAndModel)
[Open Settings](command:commitDefender.openSettings)
[Manage model API credential](command:commitDefender.manageModelCredential)

steps.title: Connect with the API key
steps.description:
Open Central Review Connection → Connect with API key…. Enter the HTTPS server URL and the API key in the password field. Confirm the server connection. All sources authorized by the key are included automatically; no repository selection is required. Use View downloaded review knowledge to inspect content and Reference sources… to limit optional sources later.
If a private CA is required, choose its public certificate file when prompted. TLS verification stays enabled. Import connection JSON… remains available for older servers.
CD stores the key in the OS credential store. Do not enter it in Settings. Initial publication and verification can take up to 60 seconds and can be cancelled.
[Open GCR connection](command:commitDefender.manageCentralConnection)

steps.title: Verify and browse central material
steps.description:
In Central Review Connection, use Connection status to check the repository, user, key expiry, last sync and snapshot. Synchronize knowledge downloads and verifies published material without calling a model.
View downloaded review knowledge shows Skills, prompts and guidance. Browse PR review history shows originals, replies, body versions and sources. Online knowledge refreshes within five minutes; revoked, expired or invalidly signed material cannot be reused.
[Open connection and history](command:commitDefender.manageCentralConnection)

steps.title: Run a review and inspect its sources
steps.description:
Save and stage a small change, then run Analyze Staged Files from the Command Palette. For an unstaged saved file, choose Analyze Current File. A review calls your selected model provider.
Check the completed, partial or failed state before reading findings. Show Summary Panel displays source references, snapshots and guidance versions. Each run pins its material versions. Past comments are observations: current code, applicability conditions and counter-evidence determine whether they apply.
Centralized · online uses online-verified material; centralized · cached uses a valid signed cache. Standalone · fallback shows the reason for reviewing without central material.
[Open review summary](command:commitDefender.showSummary)

steps.title: Resolve connection or model errors
steps.description:
401/403: check the reader client, repository permission, expiry and revocation. Repository mismatch: check Git remotes and reconnect. Certificate errors: check the HTTPS URL and administrator-provided CA; do not disable verification.
Missing central material and server outages differ from model failures. For model errors, check CD login, provider, model, reasoning, CLI support and usage limits. In Central Review Connection, Offline and fallback behavior… controls outages; Use standalone review retains the connection.
CD error notifications identify Commit Defender and the operation. Error loading webview is a VS Code viewer error, not a reader-key rejection. This native guide does not depend on the Markdown preview Service Worker.
[Open Settings](command:commitDefender.openSettings)
[Open GCR connection](command:commitDefender.manageCentralConnection)

walkthroughs.title: Commit Defender: GCR 연결 가이드
walkthroughs.description: 가이드를 읽고 계정·연결·기본 설정 화면을 엽니다.

steps.title: GCR과 CD의 역할
steps.description:
GCR에서 리뷰 이력·Skill·프롬프트·발행된 지침을 내려받고, CD에서 선택한 계정·provider·모델·reasoning으로 리뷰합니다. GCR에 연결해도 모델 선택은 유지됩니다.
로컬 코드와 리뷰 결과는 GCR에 업로드하지 않습니다. 리뷰에 필요한 소스와 문맥은 선택한 모델 provider로 전달됩니다. 계정 provider는 클라우드에서 추론할 수 있습니다.
이 가이드는 오프라인에서도 열립니다. 단계 체크는 읽은 페이지를 표시하며 연결·리뷰 성공 여부를 나타내지 않습니다.
[English](command:commitDefender.openConnectionGuide?%5B%22en%22%5D)

steps.title: GCR API key 준비
steps.description:
GCR 웹사이트의 내 프로필 → 클라이언트 설정에서 Commit Defender와 여러 저장소 또는 선택한 tenant에서 현재 접근 가능한 모든 저장소를 선택해 API key를 발급합니다. 발급 이후 추가되는 저장소는 새 key가 필요합니다.
화면의 HTTPS 서버 주소를 복사합니다. JSON은 필요하지 않습니다. 사설 CA를 사용하는 경우 공개 CA 인증서를 내려받습니다. API key는 GCR 비밀번호·GitHub 토큰·모델 API key와 별개입니다.

steps.title: 일치하는 Git 저장소 열기
steps.description:
VS Code에서 로컬 Git 저장소 또는 worktree를 열고 워크스페이스를 신뢰합니다. Git remote는 현재 저장소를 로컬에서 식별하는 데 사용합니다. 다른 저장소의 참고 자료를 조회하는 범위를 제한하지 않습니다.
연결은 현재 로컬 profile과 worktree에 적용됩니다. 현재 저장소의 정책은 자동으로 대조하고 다른 출처의 자료는 참고 자료로 구분합니다.

steps.title: 계정·모델과 설정 선택
steps.description:
계정 기반 리뷰는 계정 선택 화면에서 Codex와 모델을 선택합니다. 기존 CLI 로그인 계정을 사용합니다. 원하는 모델이 없으면 Enter a model ID…를 선택합니다. GCR의 분석용 계정은 CD에 자동 적용되지 않습니다.
기본 설정 화면에서 provider·모델·endpoint·review reasoning을 지정할 수 있습니다. API provider의 키는 Manage Model API Credential로 보관합니다. 계정과 모델은 사용자 설정(User)에 지정하십시오.
[계정과 모델 선택](command:commitDefender.selectAccountProviderAndModel)
[설정 열기](command:commitDefender.openSettings)
[모델 API 자격 증명 관리](command:commitDefender.manageModelCredential)

steps.title: API key로 연결
steps.description:
Central Review Connection → Connect with API key…에서 HTTPS 서버 주소와 API key를 비밀번호 입력란에 입력합니다. 서버 연결을 확인하면 key로 허용된 모든 자료 출처를 자동으로 포함합니다. 저장소를 선택할 필요는 없습니다. View downloaded review knowledge에서 내용을 확인하고 Reference sources…에서 선택적으로 참고 범위를 조절할 수 있습니다.
사설 CA가 필요하면 안내에 따라 공개 인증서 파일을 선택합니다. TLS 검증은 유지합니다. 이전 서버용 Import connection JSON…도 지원합니다.
키는 OS 자격 증명 저장소에 보관합니다. 설정 파일에 넣지 마십시오. 최초 발행·서명 검증은 최대 60초 정도 걸릴 수 있으며 취소할 수 있습니다.
[GCR 연결 열기](command:commitDefender.manageCentralConnection)

steps.title: 중앙 자료와 원문 확인
steps.description:
Central Review Connection의 Connection status에서 저장소·사용자·키 유효기간·최근 동기화·snapshot을 확인합니다. Synchronize knowledge는 모델 호출 없이 발행 자료를 내려받고 검증합니다.
View downloaded review knowledge에서 Skill·프롬프트·지침을, Browse PR review history에서 원문·답글·본문 버전·출처를 확인합니다. 온라인 자료는 최대 5분 안에 갱신하며 철회·만료·서명 오류 자료는 재사용하지 않습니다.
[연결과 이력 열기](command:commitDefender.manageCentralConnection)

steps.title: 리뷰 실행과 출처 확인
steps.description:
작은 변경을 저장하고 stage한 뒤 명령 팔레트에서 Analyze Staged Files를 실행합니다. stage하지 않은 저장 파일은 Analyze Current File을 사용합니다. 리뷰는 선택한 모델 provider를 호출합니다.
완료·부분 완료·실패 상태를 먼저 확인합니다. Show Summary Panel에서 지적 사항·출처·snapshot·지침 버전을 확인합니다. 실행 중에는 자료 버전이 고정됩니다. 과거 코멘트는 당시 관측이며 현재 코드·적용 조건·반증으로 적용 여부를 판단합니다.
Centralized · online은 온라인 검증 자료, centralized · cached는 유효한 서명 캐시를 사용합니다. Standalone · fallback은 중앙 자료 없이 리뷰한 이유를 표시합니다.
[리뷰 요약 열기](command:commitDefender.showSummary)

steps.title: 연결·모델 오류 확인
steps.description:
401/403이면 reader client·저장소 권한·만료·철회를 확인합니다. 저장소 불일치이면 Git remote를 확인하고 재연결합니다. 인증서 오류이면 HTTPS 주소와 관리자 제공 CA를 확인하며 검증을 끄지 마십시오.
중앙 자료 없음·서버 장애와 모델 실패는 별도입니다. 모델 오류이면 CD 로그인·provider·모델·reasoning·지원 CLI·사용량을 확인합니다. 연결 메뉴의 Offline and fallback behavior…로 장애 시 동작을 정합니다. Use standalone review는 연결 정보를 보존합니다.
CD 오류 알림은 Commit Defender와 작업명을 표시합니다. Error loading webview는 reader key 거부가 아닌 VS Code 뷰어 오류입니다. 이 내장 가이드는 Markdown 미리보기의 Service Worker에 의존하지 않습니다.
[설정 열기](command:commitDefender.openSettings)
[GCR 연결 열기](command:commitDefender.manageCentralConnection)
